name: 假设证伪实验运行器
purpose: Execute atomized claim checks and direct E0/E1 discriminating measurements without letting a model replace failed dimensions or measured outcomes with a favorable overall label.
eligibility_checks: the model has stated a falsifiable claim or at least two predictions on one measured outcome
the evaluation window and required data granularity are declared before execution
a comparison experiment names the same core mechanism and changed or isolated variable
assumptions: the supplied observations and declared granularity accurately describe the source data
mechanical name binding cannot replace independent semantic review of experiment directness
a matching prediction does not by itself prove causality
outputs: dimension-level direction, time, point, path, and invalidation outcomes without a total verdict
computed metric and E0/E1 prediction matches
bounded difference-in-differences, subgroup heterogeneity, and rolling-origin baseline diagnostics
optional advanced-result binding to one executed component, target, validation type, method, design evidence, and layer-specific design fields
an executable binding that echoes holdout evidence, exact window, granularity, measurement, and numeric predicates
supports_e0, supports_e1, mixed, not_tested, or misalignment result
diagnostics: data is coarser than the claim requires
declared evaluation window contains no usable observations
claim dimension was declared without a component
experiment target differs from the candidate core mechanism
changed or isolated variable differs from the mechanism variable
executed prediction or measurement definition differs from the frozen candidate test
competing predictions are identical or simultaneously match
evidence_requirements: read-only CSV, JSON, or inline observations
a named measurement and machine-evaluable prediction for every scored component
separate baseline and candidate predictions for a comparison
allowed_claims: an individual claim component is supported, contradicted, unverifiable, triggered, or not triggered
one declared hypothesis matches the computed result under the supplied design
the experiment is inconclusive or misaligned
forbidden_claims: an overall aligned label may override a failed component
daily data can verify an intraday timing claim
observations outside the declared window may be added after seeing the result
a mechanically bound experiment proves semantic directness or causality
one completed measurement may be relabelled as prediction, causal effect, or decision analysis
